author: PawsUnpaws_
body:
Just an idea: a list of all maps that are currently in rotation. This would allow players to see what maps are currently being used, and if one of their submitted maps is being played. I'm curious because months ago, I made a map called Cypher and it got "accepted" by one of the mods. However, I never got to play it, nor did I see it on the nebula servers, so I don't know if it ever made the cut. If there is no such list, I think it would a good feature to have. Or at least to have some way of notifying members that a map they have created and submitted is actually being played. If anyone has seen/played "Cypher" on nebula, I'd like to know, I'm curious...

P.S. Don't know what board or whatever to put this topic under. It's map related so I figured Map Making is the best option.
